title: Skillet Cornbread
description: Crisp-bottomed cornbread from a hot iron pan.
imageAlt: Golden cornbread in a cast-iron skillet with a wedge cut out

steps.title: Heat the pan
steps.text: Put a 10-inch iron skillet in the oven and heat to 425°F.

steps.title: Make the batter
steps.text: Whisk the dry ingredients. Melt 4 tablespoons of the butter and stir it in with the buttermilk and eggs.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Melt the remaining butter in the hot skillet, pour in the batter, and bake until golden and set, 18 to 20 minutes.
